title: LICHEN_RPL Kconfig selects NET_* without depending on NETWORKING (CI footgun remains)
description: 84dfe84451 fixed the two test prj.confs but rpl/Kconfig:9-10 still unconditionally selects NET_IPV6_NBR_CACHE/NET_ROUTE which only exist under NETWORKING->if NET_IPV6; any future LICHEN_RPL=y image without NETWORKING reproduces the Kconfig-abort. Add depends on NETWORKING (or conditional selects) to LICHEN_RPL.
close_reason: rpl/Kconfig LICHEN_RPL now: depends on LICHEN && NETWORKING && NET_IPV6 (NET_IPV6 added because NET_IPV6_NBR_CACHE is defined inside Kconfig.ipv6 'if NET_IPV6' - NETWORKING alone still left a gap), with comment. Audited all LICHEN_RPL=y users: tests/link_crypto, tests/rpl_routing, apps/gateway prj.conf all set NETWORKING=y + NET_IPV6=y. Verified on AWS waves-base: link_crypto .config has CONFIG_LICHEN_RPL=y CONFIG_NETWORKING=y CONFIG_NET_IPV6=y, builds clean, suite 18/18 PASS.
